sections.content: How many people are "kitchen and catering assistants"?

310,880 people

were counted on the census as "kitchen and catering assistants" in England and Wales in March 2021.

This makes this type of work the tenth most common occupation reported on the census.

Kitchen and catering assistants assist in the preparation and service of food and beverages in restaurants, cafes and other eating establishments, and perform various cleaning, fetching and carrying tasks.

People who had this job were generally younger

The occupation of "kitchen and catering assistants" had a younger age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 16 to 19 years. Of the whole working population 2.4% were aged 16 to 19 years. For people working as "kitchen and catering assistants", 17.5% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "kitchen and catering assistants" was 65 years or older.

Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "kitchen and catering assistants" included:

  • elementary sales occupations (other)
  • sales and retail assistants
  • playworkers

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "kitchen and catering assistants" there were more women than men (65.2% compared with 34.8%).

This means "kitchen and catering assistants" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "elementary administration and service occupations".

Men made up 34.8% and women made up 65.2% of "kitchen and catering assistants"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "kitchen and catering assistants" included:

  • customer service occupations (other)
  • education advisers and school inspectors
  • archivists, conservators and curators

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "kitchen and catering assistants" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged under 30 years old, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "kitchen and catering assistants" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "kitchen and catering assistants", 11.6% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a younger age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work part-time than full-time (73.6% compared with 26.4%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (97.9%) than self-employed (2.1%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
